root_cause: A TOCTOU (time-of-check/time-of-use) race condition in `inventory.js:reserveInventory()` caused the in-memory stock counter for product 7 (Ceramic Plant Pot) to be over-decremented to **-3**, permanently blocking all subsequent checkouts for that product. The error is isolated to `POST /api/checkout`; no other endpoints are affected and the pod is healthy.

Root cause confirmed: **TOCTOU (time-of-check/time-of-use) race condition** in `reserveInventory()` (`otel-demo/ecommerce/backend/src/services/inventory.js:28–111`). Four concurrent checkout requests simultaneously read `stock=5` for product 7 (Ceramic Plant Pot), all passed the guard check, then all decremented — driving the in-memory inventory to `-3`. Every subsequent checkout for that product fails immediately. The pod has not restarted, so the corrupted in-memory state persists.

Root cause: TOCTOU (Time-of-Check/Time-of-Use) race condition in `inventory.js:reserveInventory()` causing stock for product 7 (Ceramic Plant Pot) to go permanently negative, making all subsequent checkout attempts for that product fail.
